Business Development Manager Job at Kanselor Business Innovation Campus Limited




        
    

        
        Kanselor Business Innovation Campus is a business operating system that gives CEOs the insight, control, people, and processes they need to build highly profitable, scalable, and self-sustaining businesses.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Business Development Manager

Job Location: Ajao Estate, Lagos 
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Pharmaceutical

Job Summary
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	We are seeking an experienced and result-driven Product Manager to oversee product strategy, marketing, and performance.
	The ideal candidate will drive product growth, strengthen market positioning, and increase profitability.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and implement product strategies to increase sales and market share.
	Conduct market research to identify customer needs, industry trends, and competitor activities.
	Manage product launches, pricing, positioning, and promotional activities.
	Collaborate with sales and marketing teams to achieve business targets.
	Monitor product performance and recommend improvement strategies.
	Build relationships with healthcare professionals, distributors, and other key stakeholders.
	Ensure product marketing activities comply with relevant pharmaceutical regulations.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Pharmacy, Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
	Minimum of 5 years of proven experience in pharmaceutical product management or pharmaceutical marketing.
	Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical products, market trends, and marketing strategies.
	Excellent communication, analytical, leadership, and organisational skills.
	Ability to drive product growth and achieve business objectives.


Salary
N500,000 – N600,000 Monthly.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV via email to: [email protected] using the Job Position and their location as the subject line.

title: Job Openings at MykroGrid
content:
MykroGrid is a clean energy company committed to expanding access to reliable, affordable, and sustainable power solutions across underserved communities and businesses. We specialize in the design, installation, and maintenance of solar energy systems, helping homes, commercial establishments, and institutions reduce energy costs while improving energy reliability.

Our team is driven by innovation, technical excellence, and a passion for accelerating the transition to renewable energy. At MykroGrid, employees have the opportunity to work on impactful projects, develop their technical skills, and contribute to building a more sustainable future for Africa.

We are recruiting suitably qualified candidates to fill the following positions below:
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    



1.) Trainee Programme

Job Locations: Calabar - Cross River, Ekpoma & Benin City - Edo, Port Harcourt - Rivers, and Abia
Department: Sales Department

Job Summary


	Are you a fresh graduate or NYSC corps member looking to kick-start your career?
	We are seeking confident, ambitious, and teachable individuals to join our Sales Trainee Programme.


Key Responsibilities


	Proactively reach out to prospective clients through calls, emails, social media, and in-person engagements to schedule qualified appointments for the sales team.
	Build and maintain a pipeline of leads by identifying and engaging decision-makers in target markets.
	Work closely with the product marketing team to understand campaigns, messaging, and positioning, ensuring prospects receive clear and compelling information.
	Track and report daily outreach activity, appointment conversions, follow-ups, and campaign effectiveness to management on a regular basis.
	Collaborate with the sales team to ensure smooth handoff of qualified appointments and support the sales cycle.
	Gather and share feedback from prospects to help refine marketing campaigns, product positioning, and messaging.


Requirements


	Minimum of ND / OND, HND, or BSc Degree
	No prior experience required.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	Willingness to engage customers through in-person sales and marketing.
	Goal-oriented, proactive, and eager to learn.


Compensation & Benefits


	Monthly pay progression based on the programme's terms and performance.
	Fixed monthly pay increases to ?100,000 upon meeting the required sales target.
	5% commission on qualifying closed sales.
	Practical training and career development opportunities.


Click here to apply online

 

2.) Finance Manager

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Finance Manager with strong expertise in financial reporting, accounting, and financial controls. The ideal candidate must be able to produce accurate financial statements, interpret financial data, and provide reliable insights that support management decisions.


Key Responsibilities


	Prepare accurate monthly management accounts and financial statements.
	Manage budgeting, forecasting, cash flow, and financial planning.
	Oversee reconciliations, accounts payable/receivable, and payroll processing.
	Ensure tax compliance, audit readiness, and effective internal controls.
	Analyse project profitability, costs, and financial performance.
	Advise management on financial risks and business performance.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance.
	Minimum of 6 years of finance experience, including 3 years in a managerial role.
	Mandatory ACA, ACCA, or ICAN qualification.
	Strong knowledge of IFRS, financial reporting, taxation, and advanced Excel.
	Proven ability to prepare accurate financial statements and identify financial discrepancies.
	Excellent analytical skills, integrity, accountability, and attention to detail.


Salary Budget
N800,000 / Month.

Application Closing Date: 31st October, 2026.

Click here to apply online

 

 

3.) Solar Design Engineer

Job Location: Benin-City, Edo
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Purpose


	The Solar Design Engineer (SDE) is responsible for creating complete design packages for commercial and SMB solar energy systems.
	The role plays a critical part in ensuring projects are technically viable, commercially feasible, and aligned with customer energy requirements.


Key Responsibilities
Solar System Design & Documentation:


	Determine optimal system capacity and equipment configuration based on customer load profiles.
	Integrate generator and grid connections with solar and battery equipment.
	Develop single-line diagrams, electrical schematics, solar panel layouts, bill of quantities, and other technical documents.
	Clearly package design work for use by installation teams.
	Collaborate with installation teams to ensure designs are followed during installation.


Site Assessments:


	Conduct technical inspections of customer facilities.
	Evaluate roof structures, available land, electrical infrastructure, and environmental conditions.
	Measure installation areas using appropriate surveying tools.
	Assess shading, orientation, and structural integrity.
	Prepare detailed site assessment reports.


Compliance:


	Ensure designs comply with relevant technical standards and building codes


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	Design delivery time
	Design approval rate
	Technical documentation quality
	Site assessment accuracy
	Change orders resulting from inaccurate assessments or designs
	Customer satisfaction
	Installer


Requirements
Qualifications:


	Bachelor’s Degree in electrical engineering, Renewable Energy Engineering, or related discipline.
	COREN registration is an advantage.


Experience:


	3 - 4 years of hands-on experience with solar system installation. Experience on systems larger than 100kWp preferred
	Minimum of 2 years of experience with solar system design tools such as CAD, Helioscope, OpenSolar, or other similar design software
	Experience designing systems larger than 50kWp


Technical Competencies:


	Solar PV Design
	Site Survey Techniques
	Electrical Load Analysis
	CAD & Panel layout design
	Electrical Diagram preparation
	Drone Surveying (advantage)
	Engineering Documentation
	Microsoft Office Suite


Behavioural Competencies:


	Analytical Thinking
	Attention to Detail
	Communication
	Accountability
	Planning
	Technical Writing
	Initiative


Salary
N300,000 - N350,000 monthly.

Application Closing Date; 31st October, 2026.

Click here to apply online

Project Director Job at Infratel Africa




        
    

        
        Infratel Africa is a leading telecommunication infrastructure service provider in Nigeria and Sub-Saharan Africa. We provide RAN, backhaul and power as a service across Africa.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Project Director

Job Location: Abuja and Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities

	Lead the full 300-site portfolio: strategy, governance, budgets, contractors, and senior relationships with the operator and OEMs.
	Led large tower, RAN, transmission, or power rollouts
	Proven with MNOs, OEMs, and system integrators
	Commercial, contract, and risk control; PMP or PRINCE2 a plus


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree or HND in Telecoms, Electrical/Electronic, Civil, or Computer Engineering, Project Management, Business Administration, or a related field
	Willing to travel extensively and work in rural locations
	Unwavering commitment to safety, quality, and integrity
	Solar or hybrid telecom power experience a strong advantage.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV (maximum 3 pages) and a one-page note on the most relevant rollout you have delivered: sites, scope, your role and results to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.
